name: EntitySettingsDialog
description:
Every entity's Settings dialog (R12.6, glass-ux-components-plan §5.1): an `lg` dialog whose
header is the entity's identity tile with "Settings" and a data subtitle, an L3 tab rail,
and Cancel / Save. One form spans every tab, so Save sends one document.

- A tab with unsaved changes shows a neutral dot; after a refused save, tabs with errors
  show a danger dot, the dialog opens the first of them and focuses the field.
- Server errors (`SettingsSaveError.fieldErrors`) appear at their fields and clear as the
  field changes.
- Save is disabled until something changes, then confirms in place (R15.10). Changes to
  privileged fields (reassignment, credentials, routing) make it "Verify and save": a
  step-up first, then the save.
- A save refused because someone else saved first (SettingsConflictError) keeps the
  edits and says so beside Save, with Reload.
- Closing with unsaved changes asks first (R13.7). Cancel reverts and closes.
- On phones it is a bottom sheet; the rail becomes chips, or a picker past six tabs.
signature: ({ open, onOpenChange, form, tabs, tab, defaultTab, onTabChange, media, title, subtitle, entityName, onSaveError, onSaved, footerStart, size, preview, loading, saveDisabledReason, privileged, onVerify, onReload, }: EntitySettingsDialogProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: defaultTab
props.description: Initially selected tab.

props.name: entityName
props.description: Names the entity in the discard question: "Discard changes to NST-C106?".

props.name: footerStart
props.description: Tertiary footer actions on the left.

props.name: form
props.description: The form every tab edits: one `useAppForm` with the entity's Zod schema.

props.name: loading
props.description: The document is loading: every tab shows its skeleton and Save waits.

props.name: media
props.description: The entity's identity tile: its glyph or photo with the state dot.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when open change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onReload
props.description:
After a conflict (SettingsConflictError), reload the documents behind these fields: they
take the server's values and lose their edits; every other edit stays.

props.name: onSaved
props.description: After a save is confirmed (the saved values are the new baseline).

props.name: onSaveError
props.description: A save failed: the Save button shows ✕; put the reason in a toast here.

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Called when tab change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onVerify
props.description: The step-up: resolves once verified, throws if it was declined or failed.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: preview
props.description: Render in the page flow, open and non-modal (gallery specimens).

props.name: privileged
props.description:
Fields (names or prefixes) that need MFA to change (PrivilegedWrite). While the
changes include one, Save reads "Verify and save" and runs `onVerify` first. Mark their
labels with PrivilegedMark. Reads never need it.

props.name: saveDisabledReason
props.description: Why saving is unavailable, while keeping populated fields editable. Blocks submission and verification; does not imply loading.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Data only (R2.2): "NST-C106 · Northstar Studio".

props.name: tab
props.description: The open tab, when it lives in the URL (`?settings=snmp`).

props.name: tabs
props.description: Tab definitions in display order.

props.name: title
props.description: Default "Settings".
